additionalInfoHtml:
Awards and Achievements

  • Nachiketa Award: Presented by then-Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
  • Youth Literature Award: Honored by UP Governor Vishnukant Shastri.
  • Gujarat Gaurav Award: Presented by CM Vijaybhai Rupani.
  • Tathagat Award: Nepal-International Buddhist Conference.
  • Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Literature Award: Mumbai.
  • Dalit Journalists Org: Top media honor for SC/ST representation.

Social Service

  • Co-Secretary, Dalit Indian Chamber of Commerce.
  • Founder: Namaskar Research and Policy Center.
  • Provided financial support for the education of 10 underprivileged Dalit girls.
  • Operates Sanvin Viklang Vikas Trust for 100% mentally challenged daughters. Currently, 42 daughters reside there.
  • Always ready to assist youth in career and academic development.
  • Arranged payment of tuition fees for underprivileged Dalit students.
  • Worked for social equality and harmony.
  • Established ‘Social Harmony Forum’ in Gujarat.
  • Delivered lectures on Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar and participated in mass gatherings.
  • Launched the ‘Mission Bheem’ website to spread Dr. Ambedkar’s writings and ideas.
  • Member of the Gujarati Film Awards Committee of the Gujarat Government.
  • Former member of the Hindi Advisory Committee, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
  • Actively intervened in cases related to social discrimination.
  • Promoted positive government schemes in over 50 villages.
  • Took immediate action on various social incidents and worked towards their resolution.
  • Organized conferences for Scheduled Caste socio-educational institutions.
  • Donated over 15,000 books for the establishment of libraries in poor areas.
  • Opposed changes in reservation policies and led public awareness campaigns.
  • Conducted meetings of Dalit writers, journalists, and officials.
  • Participated as the keynote speaker in the Government of India’s Ministry of Communications for various government scheme promotions.

Work in the Education Sector

  • Member of Dholka School Committee.
  • Former board member of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University.
  • Delivered lectures at various universities and educational institutions.
  • Editor of the ‘Sarfaroshi’ book series.
  • Lifetime member of the Gujarati Sahitya Parishad.
  • Authored writings included in the curricula of various states

Travels and Special Work

  • Participated as a journalist in Atal Bihari Vajpayee’s historic Lahore Bus Yatra.
  • Delivered talks on various subjects on All India Radio for 15 years.
  • Visited over 15,000 villages for rural studies.
  • Connected over 100,000 people through the ‘Mission Bheem’ website.
  • Collected and compiled 500+ books on Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar, creating India’s only dedicated website for his literature.

Published Books

  • Samajik Kranti Ke Mahanayak Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar
  • Dr. Ambedkar Ka Vichar Vaibhav
  • Mahapurush Dr. Ambedkar
  • Rashtriya Purush Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar
  • Jeevan Darshan, Rashtra Darshan
  • Ajatashatru Rajpurush: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
  • Yugpurush Swami Vivekananda
  • Rashtra Ghatnachakra, Sant Ravidas
  • Safalta Ka Mantra, Shivaji Maharaj
  • Common Man Narendra Modi (Translated into multiple Indian languages)
  • Bharat Vibhajan Ki Bheetari Kahani
  • Swami Vivekananda Aur Yuva Bharat
  • Rashtra Rishi Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay
  • Narendra Modi Ke Saath Ek Mulakat
  • Surya Namaskar: Ek Sampoorna Yog
  • Maharshi Raman
  • Swabhiman Ke Tirth Sthal Aur Yatra

Translated and Edited Books

  • Vibhajan Ki Trasadi
  • Main, Manu Aur Sangh
  • Shri Guruji Sampoorna Khand
  • Samajik Samrasta (Compilation of Narendra Modi’s writings and speeches)
  • Dr. Ambedkar Vi. Khandan
  • Aarakshan Ka Satya Aur Mithya
  • Balasaheb Deoras Ki Samajik Samrasta Drishti
  • Apna Narendra Bhai (Hindi, Gujarati)
